Exposition de tissages au MoMA, premier: Weaving exhibition at MoMA, the first museum in the list of selected personal exhibitions. Consequences: Consecration of textile art; October 1949 press articles
Albers quitte le collège en 1949, estima: Albers left college in 1949, believing that the colleague of one of the founders (himself) had been mistreated despite the promise to keep him after a few years; Many leave with him, and according to him it is the “down” of the college. Consequences: Departure of several people, decline of college according to Albers
Albers quitte le collège en 1949 ; plusi: Albers left college in 1949; several people go with him. He attributed his departure to members who thought they were competent in everything and mistreated a colleague of a founder, despite the promise to keep him in office after a few years. “Plusieurs d'entre nous sommes partis” Consequences: Albers calls this departure the “déclin” of the college
Les Albers quittent le collège en 1949,: The Albers left college in 1949, after fifteen years of attendance. 15 years Consequences: End of an era
Un autre jour, une course au Sears d'Ash: Another day, a race at Sears Asheville: thirsty, she drinks at the fountain reserved for whites. High in Ohio, she knew Jim Crow but had never tasted the bitter taste of white water. “white” fountain, Sears store
Cunningham vient au printemps avant Litz: Cunningham comes in spring before Litz: demanding physics (“ne levez la jambe que si vous pouvez la lever entièrement”), excitement of physical perfection, “dance by chance”. Litz arrives in summer: what matters is what you feel when you lift your leg, composition evolving from an organic source. These two polarized views form the entire career of June. Schauffler parie deux quarts de bière qu: Schauffler bets two-quarters of beer that Rondthaler wouldn't fit in Oregon; Rondthaler accepts the bet, moves, works at the Forest Service, graduate from Reed College and career 35 years. two quarters of beer; 35 years at the Forest Service Consequences: permanent installation in Oregon; BMC friendships maintained
Jerry Wolpert, diplômé de BMC, meurt en: Jerry Wolpert, a BMC graduate, died in 1949 in Buffalo where he taught at university. Consequences: Sue Riley remarried in 1958, founded a career in early childhood education
Sept ou huit étudiants, dont VanDerBeek: Seven or eight students, including VanDerBeek (arrived in 1949), interested in architecture and meeting each week, work together for about a year, afternoon afternoon, to design and build an “Minimum House”: show that a good design is not necessarily expensive. Total cost a little over a thousand dollars, money provided by the mother of Paul Williams, stones of walls collected in the woods. La tombstone of the Dr Jalowetz, without any particular form or inscription, is laid in the rear wall. cost ~$1,000; wooden stones; Jalowetz stele in the rear wall Consequences: Involuntary macabre incident
Long compte rendu miméographié exprimant: A long mimeographed account expressing the hope of a successful reorganization, while predicting a very different college, and highlighting fifteen wonderful years and new paths that others will take up elsewhere.
Étudiant hostile pendant la lutte du pre: Hostile student during the first trimester struggle, Mitchell discovers in spring a transformed, warm and kind Albers, and develops with age affection, respect and debt towards him
Pendant l'été 1949, Natasha devient secr: In the summer of 1949, Natasha became secretary and led the search for new teachers, relying on Pittenger and Aydelotte (former boss at Swarthmore, brother of Nell Rice); Trayer provides the acting rector
Fuller accepte la direction de la sessio: Fuller accepts the direction of the summer session just after Albers and Dreier emissions; his usual honorarium went up to $1,000 a month more expensive, but he accepts what the college can pay The college pays him $800 for six weeks
Walley et Woelffer enseignent dessin, pe: Walley and Woelffer teach drawing, painting and sculpture; their women Diana Woelffer and Jane Walley host workshops in ceramics, jewellery and photography
Fuller amène neuf ingénieurs-constructeu: Fuller brings nine engineers-builders from the Institute of Design (including a Black), who ride local politicization; This time they mount a dome that holds and tests it, with so little interest for the help of students that they are deemed obsessed and Fuller inaccessible Hemisphere fourteen feet in aluminum tubes of aircraft covered with a hull of Vinylite, worked all year in Chicago; the dome flattened in September Consequences: Natasha stops talking to Fuller at the end of summer
Fuller organise une grande fête où il co: Fuller organizes a big party where he coops an impressive voice student to read one of his two hundred-page poems; Despite the drowsiness of several guests after the first hours, he happily insists on the completion of the reading Poem of 200 pages; reading several hours
Bodky dirige le volet musical de la sess: Bodky leads the music component of the summer session (while resigning from the faculty for autumn); organ point: a three-day Bach festival competing with the Cage Satie marathon the previous year
Ehrman (tissage), les Jennerjahn (danse,: Ehrman (weaving), Jennerjahn (dance, printing), Nataraj Vashi and his wife Pia-Veena (dance Hindu, Hindu philosophy conferences); Pait (philosophy and psychology) and Rosen, physicist who worked with Einstein, with Scholtz in symposia on infinity; visits by Langston Hughes and Bortai Bunting Bortai Bunting reveals that his family and Ezra Pound shared a home in Rapallo and that the youngest Pound might well be a Bunting
Faute d'argent, le collège veto son proj: For lack of money, the college vetoes its plan to bring a Washington troupe for “ré-inventer” theatre via the Homer Odyssey; Olson nevertheless produces an evening combining poetry, mime, music, colour and dance Title: “Wagadu, after Frobenius”, described as “jointure de parole-son-mouvement, projection-mélodie-geste”
Le Conseil suspend les paiements de rent: The Council suspends the rent payments to the Albers for the summer; Dreier protests with anger (“grossièrement injuste”, “manquement à la parole donnée”); Pittenger, usually soft, responds greenly that Albers has “presque coulé le bateau en désertant l'équipage”, especially since he already has a position at the Cincinnati Art Academy then Yale Salary of Albers paid all summer although he does not teach Consequences: Persistent grudge between former allies
Pour trouver l'argent, le collège vend 7: To find the money, the college sells 70 acres to the Grove Stone Company; Pittenger has been negotiating the price upwards since an initial offer of $22,500; Some teachers consider the price too low, especially since it will later be learned that neighbours had only rented their gravel rights by keeping the property $30,000 minus 10% agent commission; Forbes agrees to maintain the mortgage under its conditions and releases gravel land for sale Consequences: The college survives financially
On envisage sérieusement, étonnamment, d: We are seriously contemplating, surprisingly, to recall Rice, the only man known to be capable of holding factionalism in check, especially since he has just won Harper's centennial award for his autobiography; via Pittenger, Aydelotte says he thinks the idea is very bad Harper 100th Anniversary Award for Autobiography Consequences: Abandoned application
Des étudiants en sciences sociales parti: Social science students who went out protesting in the spring are gradually returning, as well as teachers: the Levi (he more reluctantly), Dehn full time after a year of shuttle from Wisconsin, Corkran back after illness, Hazel Larsen (photo), Jennerjahn (Colour, Modern Dance), Joe Fiore (drawing, painting), Johanna Jalowetz (relior, singing) The Ronthaler, tried for a time, remain on their island of Ocracoke Consequences: Partial re-establishment of the faculty
Bodky, Trayer et Pittenger (les deux der: Bodky, Trayer and Pittenger (the last two quakers themselves) recruit quakers: McCandless (printing), Warrington (treasurery of a non-existent office), Hetherington (harmonic, solfege, musical initiation) and his wife Louise (piano), Turner (ceramic, formerly despised by Albers as “art de cendrier”) Turner, son of Turner Construction Company, builds a wonderful oven and inaugurates a distinguished tradition of pottery Consequences: Cultural conflict with the vanguard
Un régime conservateur prenant Olivet Co: A conservative regime taking Olivet College, it is believed for a moment that a large group of dissident professors and students will migrate together; only Leser, a distinguished anthropologist, and Shepard, a linguist, accept; both formal, academic and independent, hard and eccentric Read: “Flola Shepard” in the text; Shepard will become active in local causes of civil rights Consequences: These rebels will last longer than the Quakers
Natasha écrit avoir de grands espoirs qu: Natasha writes with great hopes that next year will be a success thanks to young students, enthusiastic new teachers and veterans of the “guerres civiles”, to lead the college towards a better destiny Consequences: Black Mountain survived — not negligible feat
Albers et Dreier n'ont rendu leurs démis: Albers and Dreier only made their resignations final once Pittenger was certain to participate in the reorganization; Albers had at one point tried to make Corkran the rector.
Depuis sa visite de Black Mountain en 19: Since his visit to Black Mountain in 1948, Cage has gone to Paris where he met Pierre Boulez, who made him known the work of Antonin Artaud; Cage transmits Artaud to David Tudor and Mary Caroline Richards. Consequences: The three often read Artaud together at Black Mountain; M.C. Richards becomes one of Artaud's first translators in English
Correspondance Fuller-Goldowski de mars: Fuller-Goldowski correspondence of March 1949 (letters of 16, 22, 31 March) leading to his summer return; in interview (1969), Fuller evokes the “small ambitions” of the college. Consequences: Fuller returns in summer 1949
Exposition de couples d'artistes ; Elain: Exhibition of artists' couples; Elaine will retrospectively judge that she would discount women in the “attachant” to true artists.
Elaine joue dans le film de Burckhardt T: Elaine plays in Burckhardt's movie The Dogwood Maiden, spends the summer in Provincetown where Bill only comes once or twice; the couple has lived since 1944 in a cold water flat on Carmine Street after the sale of their 22nd Street building.
Après l'échec financier de l'école Subje: After the financial failure of the School Subjects of the Artist (Spring 1949), artists rent a “club room” on Eight Street and continue Friday evening symposia; in autumn 1949 the Club was founded, in loose affiliation with the Hans Hofmann School; it remains the epicentre of abstract expressionism during the 1950s. about twenty founding members including two women (Elaine of Kooning, Mercedes Matter) Consequences: creation of the centre of social and intellectual gravity of the movement
L'école échoue financièrement et ferme a: The school failed financially and closed in the spring of 1949, pushing artists to find their own meeting place. Consequences: Direct genesis of the Club
L'article, illustré de photos de Pollock: The article, illustrated with Pollock's photos painting his rip paints, cigarette with beak and frowned forehead, makes the romantic image of the suffering and lonely existential artist; Pollock became a celebrity overnight. pictures showing him hanging cigarette, slinging pensive eyebrows Consequences: People who had never set foot in a gallery flock to his next show at Betty Parsons, buy, invite Pollock and Lee Krasner to parties; The other artists want their share of fame.
Elaine décrit les nouvelles peintures de: Elaine describes Pollock's new paintings as violent in drawing and applying pigment but paradoxically quiet expression; It salutes the luminous networks of the great No. 1 and its range of whites, but concludes that the work is curiously uniform in its emotional content. $2 earned per report; money used to purchase equipment Consequences: She promotes what joins Bill's philosophy and disguises put-downs for what might compete with her.
Le marchand Sam Kootz charge Harold Rose: Merchant Sam Kootz commissioned Harold Rosenberg to organize the Intrasubjective exhibition of Kooning, Baziotes, Gorky, Gottlieb, Graves, Hofmann, Motherwell, Pollock, Reinhardt, Rothko, Tobey, Tomlin.
Josef et Anni passent l'été à Mexico Cit: Josef and Anni spend the summer in Mexico City where Josef gives four seminars to architectural students; When they return they move to New York. Anni's textile exhibition at the MoMA opened on September 13, 1949, organized by Philip Johnson and Edgar Kaufmann Jr.; first at the aunt of Alex Reed at 199 East 76th Street, then from October at 1245 Madison Avenue, apartment of the painter Carl Holty. Albers remembers showing for the first time its new geometrical drawings in line, future Structural Constellations. Geometric drawings on the line, investigations of impossible spatial structures. Consequences: The authors speculate on possible echoes between these drawings and Kahn's work.
Pendant ses six semaines d'enseignement: During his six weeks of teaching at the Cincinnati Art Academy, Albers takes advantage of the proximity of the Fortica Company, a leading manufacturer of laminated plastics, to engrave its Structural Constellations. Kahn approche Rohm and Haas (qui a intro: Kahn approaches Rohm and Haas (who introduced Plexiglas to the United States in 1936); Executive Edward Linforth, a 1938 graduate of painting at Yale, gladly provides Plexiglas to students. Plexiglas; Egbert Jacobson (Container Corporation of America) invited to the final jury. Anonymous report: general confusion, lack of initiative to manipulate materials. Albers disappointed, confirmed in his conviction that there is no substitute for direct material work. Dreier mène ouvertement une liaison avec: Dreier openly leads an affair with a teacher; the dual sexual standard prevails and moralists like Trayer harshly condemn Dreier to make his wife suffer and “profiter” to the other woman. Albers a récemment démissionné de Black: Albers recently resigned from Black Mountain College when Sawyer came to probe it at New York in 1950. Consequences: Opening to Yale.
